subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: The Butterfly and the Soul
description: A fast breakdown of The Butterfly and the Soul for builders.

hook.text: In Greek, the word for butterfly is 'psyche'—the same word for soul. The connection was not accidental.

buildup.text: A caterpillar enters a chrysalis and emerges transformed. Death, cocoon, rebirth. The perfect myth in nature.

discovery.text: In Aztec belief, butterflies carried the souls of fallen warriors. They returned as beautiful, fragile spirits.

twist.text: Monarch butterflies migrate thousands of miles. The Mexican Day of the Dead falls when they arrive—coincidence or not.

climax.text: The butterfly teaches that transformation requires total dissolution. You must unmake yourself to become something new.

quiz.question: What does the Greek word 'psyche' mean besides butterfly?
